text:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU allocation failure observed in gcp-west3. autoscaler reports repeated quota DENIED when trying to create n1-standard+gpu instances. queue length for inference-worker pool has grown >250 for 12m. severity: high. please acknowledge.

jordan_oncall: ack, I'm investigating. pulling autoscaler logs and quota checks.

emily_se: tagging @cloud-eng in case this is a provider-side quota propagation issue. any idea if we've hit project-level GPU hard limit?

cloud-eng: looking. quick check: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod` shows GPUs used ~62, quota 64 in region us-west3. seems we hit regional GPU quota cap.

tasha_ops: that explains DENIED. autoscaler will keep retrying and queue grows. can we reroute new allocations to us-west2 or use reserved warm pool?

sam_platform: we have spare warm pools in gcp-us-west2 and us-central1 that can take inference traffic, but routing requires updating the placement policy in the runtime. I can flip a soft-route to prefer us-west2 within 3-4m.

jordan_oncall: do it. also increase scaling backoff so we don't hammer provider APIs.

sam_platform: running routing change now: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing -d '{"prefer_regions": ["us-west2","us-central1"], "pool_selector_override": "inference-worker"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```

pagerduty-bot: @jordan_oncall acknowledged the pager. Escalation policy: oncall -> infra-sre.

cloud-eng: opened a GCP support ticket (case 123456789) requesting temporary quota bump for GPUs in us-west3. ETA from GCP support unknown.

jordan_oncall: observing partial traffic shift. queue len dropped from 260 -> 90 over 6m. latency for queued requests still elevated.

emily_se: can we enable failover to smaller GPU instance families (t4 -> a100 is reverse; we need to fall back to smaller model footprint on T4s) — i.e., change model-profile to quantized-8bit version that runs on T4? That would increase capacity on existing nodes.

sam_platform: we can push a profile toggle per-model. preparing quick patch to update model config for high-queue emergency: `POST /models/serve/config {"model_id":"rwd-llama-13b","profile":"q8_compatible"}`.

support-ops: notifying customers: we have ~14 active customers with tail latency >12s in last 15m. prepped status page message: "Degraded inference latency due to capacity provisioning delays in us-west3. Customers in affected regions may see increased latencies or request timeouts. Engineers are actively mitigating." Ready to publish on your sign-off.

jordan_oncall: publish now. include suggested mitigations for customer SDK teams: retry with exponential backoff, set shorter per-request max tokens where possible.

support-ops: publishing now. pinging top 5 paying customers individually via email and CSMs.

cloud-eng: dev note from autoscaler logs: ```2026-03-15T18:11:02Z ERROR allocation failed: quotaExceeded: compute.googleapis.com/GPUS in region us-west3. request: claim 8x t4. retries=7```

tasha_ops: we're throttling autoscaler retries to 3 attempts with exponential backoff to reduce API rate noise: `PATCH /infra/autoscaler {"max_retries":3,"backoff_base_ms":1500}`.

sam_platform: routing flip completed. new allocations now prefer us-west2; warmpool attachments in us-west2 increasing by +12 instances. visible reduction in queue: 90 -> 30 in 8 minutes.

emily_se: good. we should also proactively drain non-critical batch jobs from us-west3 to free GPUs until GCP confirms quota bump. who owns batch?

cloud-eng: @data-batch-team we need a voluntary drain: pause low-priority training jobs in us-west3 for 30m.

support-ops: customers notified, status page updated. I'll keep watch on mentions/alerts and escalate if errors persist.

jordan_oncall: summary of next steps: 1) keep routing pref to us-west2 until quota bump or until queue stable under 10. 2) block low-priority batch on us-west3 for 30m. 3) keep autoscaler retry limits low. 4) if GCP can't bump quickly, consider temporary org-level quota increase or move reserved capacity to us-west3.

cloud-eng: GCP acknowledged case and requested project justification; replied with business continuity justification and asked for accelerated review.

tasha_ops: also adding a manual override to fallback to quantized model profile for latency-critical routes: `PATCH /runtime/routes/{route_id} {"fallback_profile":"q8_compatible"}`. Doing that for top routes now.

sam_platform: confirmed route-level fallback applied for /v1/chat and /v1/generate. requests on those routes hitting us-west2 successfully.

jordan_oncall: monitoring metrics. queue 12, error rate down to baseline. assigning postmortem to emily_se to capture root cause and action items (quotas + warmpool distribution).

emily_se: on it. initial RCA notes: uneven warm-pool distribution across regions + ragged quota usage patterns (large reserved workloads pinned to us-west3) led to single-region exhaustion. draft will include runbook changes: auto-redistribute warmpool, proactive quota monitoring, and per-region reservation caps.

support-ops: closing pager for now. will reopen if queue >50 or error rate spikes. :white_check_mark:

jordan_oncall: thanks team. I'll follow up in #postmortems with timeline and logs.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for now. Duration: ~1h 22m. Root cause: regional GPU quota hit causing autoscaler allocation DENIED and queue backlog. Actions: routing failover, warmpool attach in us-west2, reduced autoscaler retries, fallback to q8 model profiles, GCP support case opened.
